//: Production settings for the published frontend. Both values are public and are fetched by the browser at startup, so they can be edited at deploy time without rebuilding. Local development is overridden by appsettings.Development.json.
//Api: The Render API origin, e.g. https://upcsg-api.onrender.com. Left empty, the public pages fall back to built-in seed data and the cart/CMS report that no API is configured.
//Google: OAuth client id from Google Cloud Console (Web application). Not a secret - it is sent to every browser; what protects the flow is the authorised-origins list on the credential and the API verifying the token server-side. Left empty, the login page offers development stand-ins instead of the real button.
